lead: Olivia Wilde is a widely followed American actor, born on 10 March 1984 in New York City.

She is associated with work such as Booksmart, Don't Worry Darling and The Invite and has been recognised with Crystal Award and Independent Spirit Award for Best First Feature.

sections.heading: Olivia Wilde — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Olivia Wilde was born on 10 March 1984 in New York City, and holds American and Irish nationality. She was given the name Olivia Jane Cockburn at birth and is publicly known as Olivia Wilde.
Public records name her father, Andrew Cockburn and her mother, Leslie Cockburn.
She received her education at Phillips Academy, Georgetown Day School and The Gaiety School of Acting.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Olivia Wilde — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists stage actor, television actor, model, film actor and voice actor as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Olivia are Booksmart, Don't Worry Darling, The Invite and I Want Your Sex.
